notes.title: Infinity Loop Bug on Game Load Fixed
notes.notes:
We've fixed an issue where the game could get stuck in an infinite loop when loading. 

Now, loading works smoothly, and you can jump straight into the action without any interruptions!

Thank you for your support! 💙

notes.title: Mega update 2020
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Developer Warnings:[/h1][/b]
The developer Softwaves, which owns the title The Village, has been sold, and we will keep the same name and some titles.
We will reformulate several titles, correct them and continue the work on Early Access titles.
We will also reformulate prices and discounts for some games and packages.

[b][h1]Title notices:[/h1][/b]
The Village is one of the titles we liked the most when we made the acquisition, not because it was the first and the most well presented, but because of the quality and the work that was done on it.

When we started reworking the title, we knew there was a lot of work to be done for shipping, and then we started, fixed user-reported flaws, made improvements to overall game performance, and finally removed the need to connect with third-party accounts (which no one really liked).

The Village has undergone a general overhaul, with significant improvements and after several tests we can say that it is ready to be played in the right way!

[b]See what we did:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved overall game performance (code optimizations)
[*] WE REMOVE THE NEED TO CONNECT WITH SOFTWAVES ACCOUNTS (THIRD PARTY ACCOUNTS), now just click on play and that's it! No complications, no fear.
[*] Correction of 34 bugs passed by users
[/list]

We know that after years with the abandoned game it will not be easy to recover the public, but we will try our best!

We want to have all the support of the community, providing us with feedback on the update, praise and criticism are welcome!

[b]The Village is more alive than ever! We hope you like this new update. We will keep the game in the best possible way.[/b]

[b][h1]Notices of upcoming releases:[/h1][/b]
For those who enjoy tycoon games, they'll love our new Freight Simulator title, which will be released May 22, 2020, Friday.

Check out more at:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208950/Freight_Simulator/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208950/Freight_Simulator/[/url]

Best regards,

Team New Waves Games.

notes.title: UPGRADING IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
[b] Accessibility problems EXTINCT! [/b]

[i] [b] More accessibility, better performance and improved hearing. [/b] [/i]

[h1] New update available, with the following improvements: [/h1]
[b] - Login with Hardware ID: [/b]
Now account creation is no longer required, any new user can play via Hardware ID, entering with just one click, without filling in login information and without the need to register.
[b] - Play offline [/b]
We've added a direct entry option to the game Lobby, where you do not have to log in, or have an internet connection to play. To enable this entry you must login at least once with your account or Hardware ID, go to settings and click on "Authorize account to play offline"
[b] - New sounds [/b]
New sounds have been added to the buttons, making game menus nicer.
New soundtrack added
[b] - Adding a "Rules Summary" of the game [/b]
It´s in the game's main menu.


[i] Good game to everyone![/i]

notes.title: Atualização de correção - Criação de contas
notes.notes:
Some users were having trouble creating their game accounts.
The problems were [b] identified [/b] and [b] corrected[/b].


Now [b]all users will be able to create their accounts as normal.[/b]



And if you still have a problem with your account, you can create a temporary account by clicking "I can not create my account" in the right corner of the registration form.
The temporary account will be reviewed and may become a definitive account within two days.

[b]In addition to the correction update and the others that are to come, the game will also be in discount between the days: 15 December 2017 until 29 December 2017, to celebrate Christmas![/b]


[i]Good game to everyone![/i]
